body: READ-ONLY SECOND REVIEW: BLOCK d4443ff as posted; no edit/claim/reservation. The Option direction is right, but one arithmetic change manufactures certainty and the evidence misses it. 1 SCIENTIFIC BLOCKER: backwardMean changed its denominator from every route step to only steps with positive forward/backward source mass, while Scaladoc still says mean per-step and the result carries no eligible-step support. Live candidate probe through HsmmResult.validated + RecallSignature.compute: four real Anna units, three valid flow steps with source-to-source masses Vector(0,0,1), only the last a backward e5->e2 move. Candidate returns discourse=Some(0), backwardMass=Some(1), worldBackward=Some(1), comparable=1/3. The documented unconditional per-step mass is 1/3. Unsupported steps were silently dropped and residue renormalized. Either preserve all-step denominator and return support beside it, or explicitly name a conditional metric and carry eligible/total support. 2 CAPACITY GAP: the new no-comparable test has zero recall units and zero flow steps; normal GraphHsmm rejects empty recall. It proves only the empty-vector branch, not a nonempty external-only transition. A mutant that returns Some(0) whenever steps.nonEmpty but no step is source-comparable survives. Add at least two contentful units and an external-only FlowStep/public inference, plus the mixed 1-of-3 probe above. 3 FINDING 4 IS PARTIAL: unknown and Missing now refuse correctly, but SignatureProjection remains a public case class over Map[String,Double] and accepts scientifically invalid constructions. Live candidate output: empty weights -> Right(0.0), NaN weight -> Right(NaN), +Infinity -> Right(Infinity). This does not satisfy the audit requirement for a typed component and finite/nonempty smart construction; either fix now or narrow the claim and file the remainder before landing. A zero weight on a Missing component also returns MissingComponent; decide/document whether zero means selected or absent. 4 TEST EVIDENCE GAPS: the missing-component test uses assume, so fixture evolution can turn it into a green skip; construct deterministic Missing or assert the precondition. The present projection test asserts only isRight, so arithmetic mutations still pass; pin the exact scalar. ClockPanel correctly carries Options in source, but no test renders None as n/a through BenchReport; its only changed test constructs Some values, so a renderer mutation can publish 0 again with a green suite. Add a missing clock report assertion. WHAT SURVIVES: discourse chronology now preserves ordered(None); ProjectionError selection is deterministic; known present terms still compose; source consumers compile. The candidate is close, but the denominator change is an estimand regression and must not land.
